title: Chapter 7
text:
What should I do? This is so awkward. Should I leave as if nothing happened and ask them to stop their performance? Han Xiao neither supported nor discriminated against this kind of special relationship. He felt that what he saw was not just two men, but two lonely hearts. The high-pressure work gave them endless pressure, and they couldn't find an outlet. Therefore, some special feelings sprouted between the colleagues they worked with every day. This is not your fault, it's all Shi Chen's fault … Bah, the world's fault!

Although his brain was thinking about this, Han Xiao's reaction was not slow at all. He held the dagger in a reverse grip and rushed toward "300,000 Thousand" like a charging leopard.

As if waking up from a dream, "300,000 Thousand" hurriedly pulled out his gun. Han Xiao saw the opportunity and swung his dagger. If "Constipation Bro" hadn't kicked "300,000 Thousand" away, the dagger would have cut off "300,000 Thousand's" wrist.

His surprise attack was dodged, but Han Xiao was not discouraged at all. With a flick of his finger, he turned the dagger from a reverse grip to a forward grip and stabbed "Constipation Bro" in the abdomen. He clenched his fist and hit "Constipation Bro" on the neck. His movements were smooth, and he was knocked unconscious.

-42！- 45！

Your STR is 25, and the target's STR is 10 … STR Authentication successful. Your STR is more than twice the target's STR. This attack has an additional 50% STR! The target is stunned.

Han Xiao's STR was more than twice the STR of these guards. His punches and kicks could cause the STR effect on the guards, as well as inflict negative statuses such as stun and broken bones.

"Very good, a threat eliminated!" Han Xiaoxin nodded.

"300,000 Thousand" who was pushed away rolled back to create a safe distance and raised his gun to shoot.

If the gunshot was heard, the whole base would be alerted. Han Xiao reacted quickly and knocked "300,000 Thousand" over with a flying tiger. They wrestled on the ground. His finger was on the trigger immediately, and he grabbed "300,000 Thousand's" wrist and smashed it hard on the ground. With a cry of pain, the gun fell out of his hand.

Han Xiao didn't stop there. He rammed his head into Three Hundred Thousand's nose. The forehead was one of the hardest parts of the human body, and Han Xiao had added 25 points of Strength to his attack. With a grunt, Three Hundred Thousand's nose was broken. Blood gushed out of his nose, and he was stunned.

Han Xiao seized the opportunity and flipped to the back of 300,000 Thousand. He locked his legs around 300,000 Thousand's waist and wrapped his arms around 300,000 Thousand's neck. He exerted force, and 300,000 Thousand's face immediately turned purple. He found it difficult to breathe and couldn't make a sound. He flailed his legs as if he was drowning.

Naked strangulation!

[You have used a sealing technique. Your STR is 25, the target's STR is 11 … Your STR has passed, the target cannot escape.]

The stalemate lasted for more than ten seconds. Three Hundred Thousand's resistance gradually weakened, and he fainted from the pressure on his neck.

"That was close …"

Han Xiao got up while panting. He felt a little emotional. If he was in the martial arts course, he would not be so tired.

The Pugilist class was the most popular class in Galaxy, for no other reason than it was cool! It was f * cking cool! The names of the moves were so cool that they were explosive, such as' King of Flame's Earth Shattering Wave ',' Magic Beam Cannon ', and' Star Crushing Fist '. It was hard to say whether the power of the moves could live up to the effect of the name, but at least it could ignite the soul of a chuunibyou. It felt like the full power of the moves could not be unleashed without shouting the name of the move. Although most players felt that it was too embarrassing, with Han Xiao's experience as a Pugilist smurf account, once he accepted this kind of setting, it actually felt quite good. Who hadn't been in the chuunibyou age before?

Furthermore, the combat style of the Pugilist class was very simple. It was just brainless hammering. Compared to the Mechanic class, which was the most difficult class to learn, it was like the difference between Angry Birds and Dark Souls. They were two completely different games.

Han Xiao had the bonus of Basic Combat and Grappling skills. Coupled with his experience as a Pugilist smurf account, his fighting ability could be considered outstanding. At least, it would not be a problem for him to deal with ordinary people.

He used his dagger to end the two people who had fainted. At this time, even the slightest bit of mercy would be cruel to himself. He also casually looted the bodies of '300,000' and 'Constipated Bro' and 'Constipated Bro' for four more gun clips.

He did not have time to rest. He moved the two bodies in, took off the combat suit of one of them, and wiped the blood in the corridor. He used the butt of the gun to smash all the surveillance screens. After checking that there were no problems, he locked the door and left the surveillance room. His expression was calm. No one could tell that he had just killed four people, and that it was his first time killing people.

It had to be said that facial paralysis was a good habit. No one could tell what he was thinking.

Cleaning up the surveillance room was like removing the eyes that were hanging above his head. He finally did not have to sneak around anymore.

When he returned to the second floor, a guard suddenly stopped Han Xiao.

"Mr. Lin Wei Xian wants to see you."

Han Xiao paused for a moment, and his eyes flashed.

Sure enough, Lin Wei Xian could not hold back anymore. He knew that this day would come, but he did not expect it to be so coincidental.

Thinking about it carefully, this might be beneficial to him. Lin Wei Xian was an important person in charge of the experiment. He had a respected status and was one of the few people who had access to the base. Han Xiao originally wanted to make a move on him, but the other party took the initiative to come knocking on his door.

…

He followed the guard to Lin Wei Xian's private laboratory. The lighting was dim, and there were bottles of transparent containers on the shelves on the wall. Human organs were soaked in formalin solution. It looked like the collection room of a psychopathic murderer.

Lin Wei Xian's eyes were burning with passion as he sized up Han Xiao. He was very happy and said excitedly,

"The organization has finally handed you over to me. As long as I dissect you, I will be able to find out why you are different from the other test subjects. Once I've discovered your value, your body will be qualified to become my specimen. My first test subject, how memorable."

Han Xiao was as silent as a rock. In the darkness, his expression could not be seen clearly.

"That guard, secure him for me. Don't let him struggle and ruin my experiment." After Lin Wei Xian finished his order, he turned his back to the two people and took out a strangely shaped scalpel and a skull opener from his toolbox. It was unknown how many human bodies it had cut open before, but the gleam of the scalpel made people shiver.

Suddenly, Lin Wei Xian heard a dull thud behind him. He turned around in confusion, only to find that Han Xiao had unknowingly stood behind him and was looking down at him.

Before he could think, Lin Wei Xian suddenly felt a sharp pain in his chest. He looked down and saw a dagger deeply embedded in his heart.

His strength was quickly draining away, and the scalpel fell to the ground with a clang.

Lin Wei Xian was horrified. He looked into Han Xiao's eyes. Those eyes were always dull, but now they were as sharp as knives, making him feel as if he had fallen into an ice cellar.

Looking past Han Xiao's body, Lin Wei Xian saw that the guard had fallen to the ground. His neck was strangely twisted, and his body, which was not completely dead, was twitching.

Lin Wei Xian's eyes were blank. He had never thought that Zero would resist. He had witnessed the entire process of Zero's brainwashing. What had gone wrong?

That's right, there's still the surveillance camera! Lin Wei Xian looked at the camera in the corner with his last hope.

Han Xiao said indifferently, "Give up. Everyone in the surveillance room is dead."

This tone … was definitely not something that the dull Zero could say!

Lin Wei Xian's body trembled. His face was ashen. He used the last of his strength to ask hoarsely, "This … this past half a year, you've been pretending?"

Han Xiao nodded.

"How is this possible … Everyone was fooled by you!" Lin Wei Xian seemed to have heard something inconceivable.

"In this world, nothing is impossible." Han Xiao twisted the dagger forcefully.

Lin Wei Xian fell to the ground with unwillingness and shock. His eyes were wide open, and he died with a grievance.

"I … am your … creator …"
